question: How must the offering to all beings be performed at the center of the maṇḍala?
premises: The location is the middle of the maṇḍala.
The offering is for all beings.
It must be given according to rule and duly.
inference: The offering to all beings should be duly given in the center of the maṇḍala according to the prescribed rule.
plain_english: In the middle of the maṇḍala, one should duly give the offering to all beings according to the rule.
